test_objective: Verify throwing 406 HTTP status code (Not Acceptable Media Type) if the "Accept" header does not imply "application/json" nor "application/ld+json"

test_cases.name: 044_04_01 endpoint get /entities/{entityId}
test_cases.doc: Verify throwing 406 HTTP status code (Not Acceptable Media Type) if the "Accept" header does not imply "application/json" nor "application/ld+json" (get /entities/{entityId})
test_cases.teardown: Delete Entity by Id Returning Response
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Get Entity Request: and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'application/xml'
}
